title: Admiral question answer
description: The answer file Commodore writes beside a question item, <inbox dir>/<id>.answer.json, when the engineer answers that item's questions in the session instead of in Admiral's inbox. Admiral counts an item as answered when this file exists (jbuffin/admiral ADR 0016, question shape). Only the question shape: review and findings items are answered in Admiral. scripts/answer-check.py checks it against its item. Validate with scripts/schema-check.py.

answered.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC, as ADR 0016 says: `date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ`.

answers.description: Question id to its answer. answer-check.py checks that the ids are exactly the item's, each answer has a choice or other, and every choice is an option label (a list only on a multi question).
